The classical/probabilistic kernel is complete deterministic support, one held classical state, total observation classes, exact positive class parts, singleton-only resolution, deterministic pushforward, exact-whole closure, successor closure and no stochastic law.

registration.statement: Classical information is one held member of a complete deterministic support with its provenance retained. Probabilistic information is the exact observation-class ledger over that same support: every class retains its deterministic microstates and exact positive part of the whole. Observation resolves a classical state only for a singleton class; otherwise it returns the complete unresolved class. Deterministic transformations push the ledger forward by exact predecessor grouping. Probability therefore describes unavailable distinctions and does not introduce stochastic dynamics, floating propensities, numerical zero or priors.
registration.title: Exact classical and probabilistic information correspondence
